answer: Sort identities at random into pods of eight strangers (an assumed size), like a job site where one skipped harness costs the whole crew its safety bonus. If an audit confirms a sybil in a pod, every member loses that epoch's bonus slice, and whoever flagged it first with evidence takes a cut. A farm dropped into an ocean of watchful strangers can't hide its thread of shared quirks for long. Evasion: own enough identities to fill whole pods, which random draws make costly. Wrongly hit: honest pod mates, who lose only the bonus, never balance; a tide of false flags costs the flagger a bond.
